parts.provenance: Original work: the in-code grid builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/grid.rs, retired with these files) made parametric in its counts, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at a 4 × 5 grid of 0.8 mm on a 5 × 4 mm body; the grid generator gives every parameter its value. Matrix, pitch, body and contact sizes are the generator's (the grid starter rows: JEDEC fine-pitch BGA conventions, typical values); land thickness, edge round and A1 dimple are estimated. No vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
